tagline.en: Hosted access to World Labs' world generation, via your own provider API key.
tagline.zh: 以自备服务商 API key 的方式接入 World Labs 的世界生成能力。

en: World Labs is a hosted world-generation service that WorldFoundry exposes through its Studio pipeline. Instead of running weights locally, you send your request to the provider's cloud, which performs the generation and returns worlds and related assets.

Because it is a hosted API, there is no model to download and no GPU to manage on your side — the trade-off is that you supply your own provider API key and rely on the external service for capability, availability and cost.
zh: World Labs 是一项托管的世界生成服务，WorldFoundry 通过 Studio pipeline 接入它。你无需在本地运行权重，而是把请求发送到服务商云端，由其完成生成并返回世界及相关资源。
由于是托管 API，你这边无需下载模型或管理 GPU——代价是你需要自备服务商 API key，能力、可用性与费用都依赖这项外部服务。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want world generation without provisioning local hardware, and are comfortable calling a cloud service through an API key.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想获得世界生成能力、又不想配置本地硬件，并愿意通过 API key 调用云端服务时，可以使用它。

notFor.en: You must provide your own provider API key, and output, availability and cost all depend on the external service rather than on WorldFoundry.
notFor.zh: 你需要自备服务商 API key，且输出、可用性与费用均取决于外部服务，而非 WorldFoundry。

en: Hosted service — no local weights or GPU needed
World generation and related assets through one pipeline
Requires your own provider API key
zh: 托管服务——无需本地权重或 GPU
通过同一 pipeline 获取世界生成及相关资源
需自备服务商 API key
